scripts.build: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py verify
scripts.build:ship-bundle: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py build
scripts.build:portable-exe: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py build
scripts.verify:portable: npm run check:python-version && python scripts/orchestrator.py verify
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:cold: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --rebuild --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-mode cold --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.probe:desktop:startup:warm: npm run check:python-version && python src/packaged_desktop_smoke.py --rebuild --startup-probe --profile-only --profile-mode warm --runtime-timeout 60
scripts.test:py:timing: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q --durations=25 --durations-min=0.2 --color=no
scripts.test:py:cov: npm run check:python-version && python -m pytest tests -q -m "not slow" --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing --color=no
